response.script_hint: Tip: if your task requires multiple tool calls, use execute with a script to chain them in a single call and reduce token usage.
response.summary: Found 12 tools matching "rule draft publish revision"

rows: Add a targeting rule (force value, percentage rollout, or experiment-ref linking an A/B test) to a GrowthBook feature flag, in a draft revision. Nothing goes live: the result has the draft version and rule ids; publish it with growthbook_publish_feature_revision. Omit version to start a new draft from the live revision. The rule must name its environments. Use after growthbook_get_feature and growthbook_list_attributes.

rows.revision_comment: Optional markdown for reviewers: what changes and why (new draft only)
rows.revision_title: Optional short title for a new draft
rows.rule: JSON object. type: force (default), rollout or experiment-ref. environments: ["production"] or allEnvironments: true (required). force/rollout: value (string form, e.g. "true" or a JSON string), condition (MongoDB-style JSON string on attributes, e.g. {"cbsa_name": "38300"}), description, enabled; rollout also coverage (0-1) and hashAttribute. experiment-ref: experimentId and variations [{variationId, value}]
rows.version: Optional draft revision version to add to; omit to create a new draft

rows: Remove one targeting rule from a GrowthBook feature flag in a draft revision. Nothing goes live until growthbook_publish_feature_revision.

Change fields of one targeting rule of a GrowthBook feature flag in a draft revision (condition, value, coverage, environments, enabled, variations). The rule type cannot change. Nothing goes live until growthbook_publish_feature_revision. Get rule ids from growthbook_add_feature_rule or growthbook_list_feature_revisions.

rows.rule: JSON object with only the fields to change

rows: Publish a GrowthBook feature flag draft revision: its rules go live to every SDK in the environments they target. Only call this when a person has asked for the change to go live; show them the draft first (growthbook_list_feature_revisions). Gates GrowthBook enforces (required review, warnings, schema) come back as an error for a person to resolve; they are never bypassed. Returns pending_confirmation if the API key needs a person to confirm.

rows.comment: What goes live and why, recorded in the audit log

rows: Create a GrowthBook A/B test experiment as a draft: nothing is served until it is linked to a flag with an experiment-ref rule (growthbook_add_feature_rule) and started (growthbook_start_experiment). Check growthbook_list_data_sources, growthbook_list_fact_metrics and growthbook_list_projects first.

rows.experiment: JSON object: trackingKey, name, variations [{key: "0", name: "Control"}, {key: "1", name: "Treatment"}] (required); project, hypothesis, description, owner, hashAttribute, datasourceId, assignmentQuery {id}, metrics, guardrailMetrics, tags, phases [{name, dateStarted, coverage, targetingCondition, trafficSplit}]. status is always draft

rows: Discard a GrowthBook feature flag draft revision without publishing it. The live revision is unchanged.
List GrowthBook targeting attributes (user properties such as id, country, deviceType) with data type, enum values and which one is used for hashing. Use to write or understand targeting conditions.
Get one GrowthBook saved group (audience) including its condition or list of member values. Use after growthbook_list_saved_groups to see exactly who a targeting rule includes.

Get one GrowthBook feature flag by key: default value, per-environment enabled state, targeting rules with conditions, saved groups, rollout coverage and linked experiments, prerequisites, and the published revision version. Use after growthbook_list_features.

Turn a GrowthBook feature flag on or off (enable, disable, kill switch) in exactly one environment. Publishes a new revision; does not edit rules. If the API key requires confirmation, returns status pending_confirmation with a link for a person instead of applying it. Use after growthbook_get_feature to confirm the current state.

rows.enabled: true to turn the flag on in that environment, false to turn it off
rows.environment: Environment id to change (e.g. production); never defaults
rows.reason: Optional reason recorded in the GrowthBook audit log

rows: List GrowthBook A/B test experiments with status (draft, running, stopped), variations, traffic split per phase, goal metrics, linked flag keys and the result summary (won, lost, inconclusive). Start here for GrowthBook experiment analysis and finding an experiment id. Paginated with limit/offset.

rows.archived: Optional boolean; true returns only archived experiments, false only active ones
rows.offset: Pagination offset (default 0); use nextOffset from the previous page
rows.search: Optional search text (same syntax as the GrowthBook experiment list filter)
rows.status: Optional status filter: draft, running or stopped

rows: Start a draft GrowthBook experiment: users matching its targeting are assigned to variations from the SDKs' next refresh, and feature drafts linked to it may be published with it. Only call this when a person has asked to launch. An incomplete launch checklist or a required approval comes back as an error for a person; it is never skipped.
